messages.subject: Error running geography file
parts:
Hi,

I was able to run the example code properly, but when I use my own datasets it gives me the following error - 
Read 6 items
Read 30 items
Error in getranges_from_LagrangePHYLIP(lgdata_fn = geogfn) : 
  could not find function "define_tipranges_object"

I tried to make sure the tip labels and the labels of the ranges are the same and the tree is time-calibrated.
I have attached my files.

messages.author: 665b3d97beb30882
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Error running geography file
parts:
Hi Anurag,

There are multiple issues, please see below.

On Tue, Nov 17, 2015 at 7:45 AM, Anurag Mishra <anuragmi...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi,

I was able to run the example code properly, but when I use my own datasets it gives me the following error - 
Read 6 items
Read 30 items
Error in getranges_from_LagrangePHYLIP(lgdata_fn = geogfn) : 
  could not find function "define_tipranges_object"

I tried to make sure the tip labels and the labels of the ranges are the same and the tree is time-calibrated.
I have attached my files.

The function "define_tipranges_object" is a BioGeoBEARS function, so if the function can't be found, that means either you didn't actually do library(BioGeoBEARS), or you didn't do the source() commands as instructed in the script. You have to re-run these commands *every single time* you re-start R. 


Anyway, I looked at your data files, there are multiple issues.

Tree file:
1. You have 2 branches of 0 length. I fused Emac and Emel into Emac_Emel
2. Your branch lengths in general are very short (< 0.05).  Are these actually times in millions of years?  I multiplied the branch lengths by 1000.

Geography file
1. I changed Emac to Emac_Emel and removed Emel
2. Minor changes to tabs/spaces in the first line. See the corrected file, attached. 

OK, with all of that, it runs. Everything is attached.

Cheers,
Nick
